# Anubhav Gain

> Anubhav Gain (mranv) is a security engineer in Mumbai, India, building endpoint control, XDR pipelines and Rust security tooling at Infopercept. He founded Gain Fisheries, a fish hatchery in Pakhanjur, Chhattisgarh, in 2020.

This file mirrors the facts on https://mranv.github.io/ (the canonical page). Keep the two in step when either changes.

## Profile

- Role: Security Engineer, Infopercept (Jul 2024 – present)
- Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- Education: B.Tech, Cyber/Computer Forensics and Counterterrorism, Parul University; ransomware techniques and cybersecurity management, Charles Sturt University
- Focus: endpoint security, application allow-listing, XDR / SIEM (Wazuh, OpenSearch), application security and VAPT, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, Rust, Go, eBPF
- Contact: iamanubhavgain@gmail.com

## Engagements

- Mahindra Finance, endpoint security consultant (May 2026 – present): Invinsense 7.0 Unified Endpoint Control, application allow-listing, policy review to deployment workflows, endpoint telemetry across Windows, macOS and Linux.
- Infopercept, security software engineer (Jul 2024 – present): deployment architecture for Invinsense XDR / OXDR (single and multi-tenant), custom OpenSearch Dashboards plugins, Rust monitoring agents, Wazuh + Fluent Bit alert pipelines.
- SBI Life, application security consultant (Mar – May 2026): application security assessments and VAPT, design reviews against financial-sector and data-protection standards.

## Open source

- [eBPF File Monitor](https://github.com/mranv/ebpf-file-monitor): Rust, kernel-level file telemetry
- [Krustron](https://github.com/anubhavg-icpl/krustron): Go, GitOps across Kubernetes clusters
- [Agni](https://github.com/anubhavg-icpl/agni): Go TUI for Firecracker microVMs
